battleTraits.name: Endless Growth
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:


• **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
battleTraits.effectPlain:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:


• Heal (X) the target, where X is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.

battleTraits.name: The Creeping Overgrowth
battleTraits.effect:
The **creeping overgrowth** is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**. The range of the **creeping overgrowth** is based on the number of friendly, **overgrown tokens** on the battlefield as shown:

• 0-2 **overgrown tokens**: 6"
• 3-5 **overgrown tokens**: 9"
• 6-8 **overgrown tokens**: 12"
• 9+ **overgrown tokens**: Whole battlefield


***Designer's Note**: Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to too.*
battleTraits.effectPlain:
The creeping overgrowth is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the creeping overgrowth is based on the number of friendly, overgrown tokens on the battlefield as shown:

• 0-2 overgrown tokens: 6"
• 3-5 overgrown tokens: 9"
• 6-8 overgrown tokens: 12"
• 9+ overgrown tokens: Whole battlefield


Designer's Note: Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to too.

battleTraits.name: Fury of The Forest
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: The unit using this ability has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.effectPlain: The unit using this ability has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: The Land Awakens
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Revenant Infantry^^** unit or friendly **Dryads** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Setup a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.effectPlain: Setup a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Reclaimed By Nature
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
battleTraits.effectPlain: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, you can set up an Awakened Wyldwood on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly Awakened Wyldwoods and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

battleTraits.name: Creeping Dread
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a **^^Hero^^** in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
battleTraits.effectPlain: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a Hero in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Nature's Titans
abilities.effect: When using the 'Endless Growth' ability, do not roll a D3 for **^^Monster^^** targets. Instead **Heal (3)** each of those targets.
abilities.effectPlain: When using the 'Endless Growth' ability, do not roll a D3 for Monster targets. Instead Heal (3) each of those targets.

abilities.effectPlain: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy Warmaster.

abilities.effectPlain: If this Manifestation is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-Wizard non-Priest units and more than 3" from all enemy Wizards and enemy Priests.

abilities.name: Feed on Eldritch Energy
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls, unbinding rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^**
abilities.effectPlain: Subtract 1 from casting rolls, unbinding rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this Manifestation

abilities.name: Anger The Hive
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this **^^Manifestation^^** was not set up this turn, add 10 to the Attacks characteristic of this **^^Manifestation^^**'s ranged weapons for the rest of the phase, but all of the shooting attacks it makes this phase must target an enemy unit within 9" of it.
abilities.effectPlain: If this Manifestation was not set up this turn, add 10 to the Attacks characteristic of this Manifestation's ranged weapons for the rest of the phase, but all of the shooting attacks it makes this phase must target an enemy unit within 9" of it.

abilities.name: Slay The Trespassers!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: Rolla dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Rolla dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Wardroth Beetle's Antlers** is 4.
abilities.effectPlain: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Wardroth Beetle's Antlers is 4.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target would be destroyed by this spell, before removing any models, pick the closest terrain feature to the target that does not have a friendly **overgrown token** and give it a friendly **overgrown token**. If all terrain features on the battlefield already have a friendly **overgrown token**, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6" of the target instead.
abilities.effectPlain: Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target would be destroyed by this spell, before removing any models, pick the closest terrain feature to the target that does not have a friendly overgrown token and give it a friendly overgrown token. If all terrain features on the battlefield already have a friendly overgrown token, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6" of the target instead.

abilities.name: Lifebloom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: **Heal (2D6)** this unit.
abilities.effectPlain: Heal (2D6) this unit.

abilities.name: Living Battering Ram
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Goddess Of Life
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with 8 damage points allocated to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up a replacement unit with 8 damage points allocated to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points) wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Seasons Of War
abilities.timing: Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round. You cannot pick the effect that you picked in the previous battle round.


***The Burgeoning***: Each time a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** uses the 'Ever Growing' ability, you can pick any terrain feature your opponent does not control to be the target rather than the closest.

***The Reaping***: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.


***The Dwindling***: Friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** units can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those units when they use **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

***Everdusk***: Each time you use the 'Creeping Dread' ability this battle round, you can pick up to 3 targets instead of 1.
abilities.effectPlain:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round. You cannot pick the effect that you picked in the previous battle round.


The Burgeoning: Each time a friendly Awakened Wyldwood uses the 'Ever Growing' ability, you can pick any terrain feature your opponent does not control to be the target rather than the closest.

The Reaping: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly Sylvaneth units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.


The Dwindling: Friendly Sylvaneth units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Retreat ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those units when they use Retreat abilities.

Everdusk: Each time you use the 'Creeping Dread' ability this battle round, you can pick up to 3 targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: Groundshaker
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy non-**^^Fly Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice, On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a dice, On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Guardian Sword** is 3.
abilities.effectPlain: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Guardian Sword is 3.

abilities.name: Guardian Of The Glades
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the charge roll but this unit must end that charge move within 1/2" of an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **^^Sylvaneth Hero^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 2 to the charge roll but this unit must end that charge move within 1/2" of an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly Sylvaneth Hero.

abilities.name: Huntmaster's Strike
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units and wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.
abilities.effectPlain: If this unit charged this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units and wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

abilities.name: Kurnothi War-horn
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Kurnothi^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly Kurnothi units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Rhythm of the Chase
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll, then you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 1" of the target.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll, then you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 1" of the target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnelian Greatspite's Mandibles** is 3.
abilities.effectPlain: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Carnelian Greatspite's Mandibles is 3.

ability.name: Spellsinger
ability.effect:
If this unit is a ^^**Wizard**^^, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a ^^**Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it has **^^Wizard(1)^^**.
ability.effectPlain:
If this unit is a Wizard, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a Wizard, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it has Wizard(1).

ability.name: Spirit of The Dark Forest
ability.timing: Once Per battle, Enemy Hero Phase
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy ^^**Hero^^** to be the target.
ability.effect: Halve the target's Move characteristic the rest of the turn.
ability.effectPlain: Halve the target's Move characteristic the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Realmroot Guide
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit. within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.effectPlain: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Seed of Rebirth
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a die. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. **Heal (D3)** this unit.
ability.effectPlain: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a die. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Heal (D3) this unit.

ability.name: Amberglade Nectar
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
ability.effectPlain: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Companion weapons used by friendly Sylvaneth units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Wychwood Glaive
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
ability.effectPlain: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.

ability.name: Dancing Mystiflies
ability.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a ^^**Spell**^^ ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
ability.effect:
• If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.
• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the creeping overgrowth, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.
ability.effectPlain:
• If this unit is not a Wizard, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1). Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.
• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the creeping overgrowth, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Amulet of Resonance
ability.effect: If this unit used the 'Eruption of Fury' ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit.
ability.effectPlain: If this unit used the 'Eruption of Fury' ability this turn or you spent rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly Sylvaneth Priest wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Glamourweave
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
ability.effectPlain: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.
ability.effectPlain: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

restrictions.raw: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Monster Sylvaneth^^** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

ability.name: Aspect of Ironbark
ability.effect: When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit's damage pool. After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle.
ability.effectPlain: When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit's damage pool. After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Aspect of Heartwood
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the 'Endless Growth' ability
ability.effect:
If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would Heal **(3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
• If the target is **^^Kurnothi^^**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.
ability.effectPlain:
If this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would Heal (3) the target instead of rolling a dice, Heal (6) the target instead.
• If the target is Kurnothi, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.
